blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce DyShip, a framework for classifying speaker familiarity and kinship from dyadic conversations in the Seamless Interaction corpus. We compare five speech representations: spectrograms, MFCCs, self-supervised WavLM representations, x-vectors, and estimated articulatory movements. Spectral features perform best for familiarity classification, reaching an accuracy of 87.81%, while WavLM achieves the highest kinship accuracy of 85.17%. X-vectors and articulatory features yield weaker results on familiarity classifiaction, but shine for kinship classification, with an AUC of 0.909 for x-vectors. Most classifiers exceed previously reported human and audio language model scores on the same dataset. These findings highlight the potential of conventional acoustic features for relationship inference and motivate further investigation of the conversational cues captured by different representations.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了DyShip,这是一个框架,用于将演讲者熟悉程度和亲属关系从无缝互动体中的对话分类。 我们比较了五个语音表达法:分谱法,MFCC法,自我监督的WavLM表达法,x-vector法,以及估计的动脉运动. 光谱特征最能表现为熟悉分类,精度达到87.81%,而WavLM的亲和度最高为85.17%. X-活性与活性特征在熟悉分類上产生更弱的结果,但为亲缘分类而发光,X-活性为0.909的AUC. 大多数分类器都超过了以前报道的同一数据集的人语和音频语言模型得分. 这些结论突出了传统声学特征对关系推论的潜力,并促使人们进一步调查不同表述所抓住的对话提示.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Spoken dialogue is a rich form of interaction between two individuals; it contains a large set of information beyond its transcript: the identity of speakers, and their individual characteristics, such as their age, gender, and accents, can be predicted from their speech [ 9 , 21 ] .
Beyond the static characteristics of a speaker, previous works have shown that during oral interactions, one speaker tends to modify their speech to adapt to the other one, both lexically [ 3 ] and acoustically [ 11 ] , a phenomenon known as speech entrainment.
Further works have shown that this entrainment is correlated with social relationships between speakers [ 2 ] .
Similarly, individuals of the same family exhibit similar speech patterns: children follow some habits from their parents [ 14 ] , family groups exhibit coherent syntax [ 7 ] , and even some vocal tract similarities can be measured [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh:
口语对话是两个人之间一种丰富的互动形式;它包含大量超出笔录的信息:发言者的身份,以及他们的个人特征,如年龄,性别和口音,可以从他们的演讲中预测[9,21].
除了一个发言者的静态特征外,以往的著作已经表明,在口头互动中,一个发言者倾向于修改其发言,以适应另一个发言者,在逻辑上[3]和声学上[11],这种现象被称为语音内涵.
进一步的工作表明,这种内涵与发言者之间的社会关系有关。
同样,同一家庭的个人也表现出相似的语音模式:儿童遵循父母的某些习惯[14],家庭群体表现出连贯的语法[7],甚至一些声道相似之处可以测量[20].

blocks.en:
Building on the recently published Seamless Interactions dataset [ 1 ] , which contains short spoken dialogues among speakers whose relationship is labeled, recent unpublished works have been looking into predicting the relationship between speakers from the transcript or the spoken interaction [ 12 , 10 ] FriendBench [ 10 ] used the first 20 seconds of dialogues and asked text, audio, and video large language models (LLM) to predict the familiarity of the speakers as a binary output, reaching respectively 56.2, 66.7, and 66.7% accuracies with their best LLM. Comparatively, individual human raters showed up to 49.9, 56.3, and 60.9% accuracies, respectively.
Comparatively, [ 12 ] used the full conversations, up to 5 minutes, and compared different prompting techniques to improve LLM performances on the transcript and the audio, yielding up to 75.0% accuracy using an audio LLM (Compared to 62.3% using a zero-shot prompt). With access to the full dialogue, individual annotators obtained a 65.4% F1 score when given both the full transcript and audio.
As LLM inference is getting increasingly costly and human annotation can be as costly and time-consuming, this pushes forward the interest toward simpler classification systems.

在最近出版的无缝互动数据集[1]的基础上,最近未出版的作品正在研究从记录稿或口语互动中预测发言者之间的关系[12、10] Friend Bench [10] 使用了最初的20秒钟对话,并询问文本、音频和视频大语言模型(LLM),以预测发言者是否熟悉二进制产出,分别达到56.2、66.7和66.7%的速率。 相比之下,个人的评分率分别为49.9、56.3和60.9%。
相比而言,[12]利用了完整的对话,最长为5分钟,并比较了不同的提示技术来改进记录誊本和音频的LLM性能,使用音频LLM得出高达75.0%的准确度(压缩到62.3%使用零射速率). 通过全面对话,个别注释员在获得完整记录和音频时获得了65.4%的F1分。
由于LLM推论越来越昂贵,而人的注释可能同样昂贵和费时,这推动了人们对更简单的分类系统的兴趣。

blocks.en:
In this work, we train binary classifiers to predict relationships between 2 speakers given a dialogue.
We predict both familiar-versus-stranger classification, as defined in the labels of Seamless Interactions [ 1 ] , as well as the belonging to ones family, which will be refered as kinship .
The classifiers are trained on spectral features (Spectrograms and MFCCs), on Self-Supervised Learning Representations (SSLR, here we use WavLM [ 5 ] ), using vocal tract estimations (predicted by the SPARC system [ 6 ] ) and x-vectors [ 19 , 8 ] .
Our contributions are threefold: • We introduce DyShip , a framework for familiarity and

the Seamless Interaction corpus [ 1 ] . • We systematically compare five speech representations,

and x-vectors perform best for kinship classification. • We provide a reproducible pipeline for feature extraction,
classifier training, and conversation-level inference, together

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: 2.1 Speech Representations
blocks.zh: 2.1 发言陈述

blocks.en:
Speech representations capture complementary aspects of the speech signal, ranging from spectral structure to learned speaker characteristics and articulatory information.
For a long time, spectral representations in speech processing have been the norm: spectrograms describe the distribution of signal energy across time and frequency, while Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients ( MFCCs ) provide a compact representation of the spectral envelope, most useful for speaker recognition tasks.
More recently, self-supervised models such as WavLM [ 5 ] learn contextual representations from large speech corpora, supporting the extraction of information relevant to multiple speech processing tasks.
Speaker embeddings, commonly referred to as x-vectors [ 19 ] , instead emphasize speaker-discriminative characteristics; in this work, they are extracted using ECAPA-TDNN [ 8 ] .
Finally, articulatory representations offer a description of speech production: SPARC [ 6 ] estimates vocal tract movements from audio, using a fine-tuned WavLM system and a classification head, including the movements of the lips, jaw, and tongue. Comparing these representations allows us to investigate whether speaker relationships are better predicted from conventional acoustic features, general-purpose learned representations, speaker identity cues, or estimated articulatory dynamics.
blocks.zh:
语音表达能捕捉语音信号的互补方面,从光谱结构到学习的语音特征和动脉信息.
长期以来,语音处理中的光谱表示一直是常态:光谱描述信号能量在时间和频率上的分布,而Mel-频率cepstral系数(MFCCs)则提供光谱信封的紧凑表示,对扬声器识别任务最为有用.
最近,WavLM[5]等自我监督的模型从大型语音公司学习背景表述,支持提取与多个语音处理任务相关的信息.
扬声器嵌入,通常称为x-vectors [19],而是强调扬声器-歧义特性;在本作品中,它们使用ECAPA-TDNN[8]进行提取.
最后,动脉表达法提供了语音制作的描述:SPARC [6] 使用微调的WavLM系统和分类头来估计声道运动,包括嘴唇,下巴和舌头的运动. 比较这些表达方式,我们可以调查发言者的关系是否从常规的声学特征、通用的学习表达方式、发言者身份提示或估计的动脉动态得到更好的预测。

blocks.en: 2.2 Human and LLM perfomances
blocks.zh: 2.2 人体和LLM精液

blocks.en: Recent studies have investigated how accurately humans and large language models can infer speaker relationships from conversational cues. FriendBench [ 10 ] evaluates 26 models from seven companies on familiarity classification using 20-second excerpts from 96 balanced dyads in the Seamless Interaction dataset. Its comparison of text, audio, and video inputs highlights the contribution of non-textual cues, with audio-based predictions outperforming those based on transcripts alone. The study also reports a tendency for models to predict strangers, whereas human judgments are more balanced. Complementing this short-excerpt setting, concurrent work [ 12 ] examines relationship inference using full conversations and different prompting strategies, providing additional human and LLM reference results. These studies motivate our investigation of acoustic representations by showing that conversational speech contains cues relevant to relationship inference, while leaving open which representations capture them most effectively. We use their reported results to contextualize our classifiers, while recognizing differences in input duration, supervision, and evaluation protocols.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究研究了人类和大语言模型如何精确地从对话提示中推断演说者关系. Friend Bench [10] 利用无缝相互作用数据集96个均衡的二亚目的20秒节选,评价7家公司的26个模型的熟悉分类. 它对文本、音频和视频投入的比较突出了非文本提示的贡献,而基于音频的预测比仅基于记录誊本的预测要好。 该研究还报告模型预测陌生人的倾向,而人类判断则更为平衡. 为补充这一短篇摘要设定,同时进行的工作[12]利用充分对话以及不同的促动策略,审查关系推论,提供更多的人和LLM参考结果。 这些研究激励了我们对声波表达的调查,表明对话演说包含与关系推论相关的提示,而留下了最能有效捕捉到这些暗示的空洞。 我们利用它们报告的结果,使我们的分类人员结合背景,同时认识到投入期限、监督和评价协议的不同。

blocks.en: 3 Materials and Methods
blocks.zh: 3 材料和方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en:
We use the Seamless Interaction dataset [ 1 ] , which contains over 4,000 hours of recorded dyadic interactions from over 4,000 participants. The dataset includes diversity in participant age, race, gender, and education level, and provides a range of naturalistic and acted speech interactions, guided by conversational prompts. The naturalistic subset also contains interpersonal relationships labels for 11 relation classes: ’strangers’ are neither familiar nor kinship , ’friends’ , ’coworkers’ , ’roommates’ , ’romantic partners’ , ’classmates’ , ’neighbors’ , and ’generic familiar’ are defined as familiar relations but non-kin , while ’siblings’ , ’parent-child’ pairs, and ’generic family’ are both kinship and familiar .
We used the train, development, and test splits provided by Seamless Interaction to ensure that no participant is shared between splits.
For the training and development sets, we only kept utterances that were at least five seconds long, and segmented longer utterances into five second segments.
In contrast, the test set included all utterances to match previous evalutation frameworks.
We also excluded interactions that did not involve exactly two participants or for which the interpersonal relationship label was not in the metadata. Lastly, interactions missing dyad IDs from the metadata were retained only in the training set.
Table 1 summarizes the sizes of the resulting datasets after applying these criteria.
The final dataset contains 5.14% conversations from kin dyads, and 51.00% from familiar dyads.
blocks.zh:
我们使用无缝相互作用数据集[1],其中包含来自4000多名参与者的4000多小时记录的异态相互作用. 数据集包括参与者年龄、种族、性别和教育程度的多样性,在对话提示的指导下,提供一系列自然主义和动作语言互动。 自然主义的子集还包含了11个关系类的人际关系标签: 'srangers'既不是熟悉的,也不是亲缘关系, '朋友', '同事', '室友', '浪漫伴侣', '同学', '邻居'和 '天才熟悉 ' 被定义为熟悉的关系,但并非亲缘关系,而 '兄弟', '父母-孩子的对子 ' 和 '基因家庭 ' 既是亲缘关系又是熟悉的。
我们利用无缝相互作用提供的列车、开发和试验分路,确保没有参与者在分路之间共享。
对于培训和开发节目,我们只保留了至少5秒钟长的言论,将更长的言论分成五个第二段。
与此相反,测试集包括了所有与之前的估价框架相匹配的语句.
我们还排除了没有完全涉及两个参与者或元数据中没有人际关系标签的互动。 最后,仅在培训中保留了元数据中缺失的识别码。

blocks.en: 3.2 Models
blocks.zh: 3.2 模式

blocks.en: Figure 1: Schematic of the pipeline: Each utterance is processed separately by different feature extractor, then by a dedicated classifier to predict the probability per utterance, aggregated into a probability per conversation.
blocks.zh: 图1:管道结构: 每句话由不同的特性提取器分别处理,然后由专门的分类器来预测每句话的概率,汇总成每个对话的概率.

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Features

We train one binary classifier per feature and per task, considering five representations: Spectral : MFCCs and spectrograms are extracted using Pytorch [ 15 ] . SSLR : We extract representations from the final layer of the frozen WavLM-base-plus [ 5 ] model, yielding 768 dimension embeddings. Vocal Tract : The pretrained SPARC model [ 6 ] is used to predict 6 vocal tract movements in the sagittal plane across six articulators: the upper lip, lower lip, lower incisor, tongue tip, tongue blade, and tongue dorusm. x-vectors are extracted using the pretrained ECAPA-TDNN [ 8 ] from Speechbrain [ 18 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们每个功能和任务训练一个二进制分类器,考虑五个表述: Spectral : MFCCs and spectrogram 使用pytorch [15] 提取. SSLR: (英语). 我们从冰冻的WavLM-base-plus[5]模型的末层提取表达,产生768维嵌入. Vocal tract : (英语). 预受训练的SPARC模型[6]用于预测6声道在agi平面上的声道运动,跨越6个动脉:上唇,下唇,下肠,舌尖,舌叶,和舌头多鲁姆. 使用 预训的ECAPA-TDNN [8] 从Speechbrain [18].

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Classifiers

For MFCC, spectrogram, WavLM, and SPARC representations, we used a ResNet-34 classifier [ 13 ] with a binary classifier head.
For X-Vector representations, we used a non-linear support vector machine (SVM) classifier from scikit-learn package [ 17 ] . The X-Vector representations are standardized using StandardScaler before classification, and we use a radial basis function (RBF) kernel, set the C value to 1, set the gamma value to scale, and balanced class weights. We also used this classifier architecture for fusion models.
blocks.zh:
对于MFCC,光谱学,WavLM,以及SPARC的表示,我们使用了ResNet-34分类器[13],并带有二进制分类器头.
对于X-Vector表示器,我们使用了Scikit-learn包中的非线性支持矢量机(SVM)分类器[17]. X-Vector表示法在分类前使用标准分级器进行标准化,我们使用射线基函数(RBF)内核,将C值设定为1,将γ值设定为比例,平衡类权重. 我们还用这个分类架构来进行核聚变模型.

blocks.en: 3.3 Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.3 计量

blocks.en:
We evaluated each model at the conversation level using unweighted accuracy, macro f1 score, and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC).
All the metrics are evaluated on the conversation-level probabilities P ⁡ ( D i , j | f , C i , j ) P(D_{i,j}|f,C_{i,j}) .

所有衡量标准都通过对话水平概率PQQ(Di, j | f, Ci, j )P(D_{i, j}|f, C_{i, j)来评价.

blocks.en: 3.4.4 The X-vector exception
blocks.zh: 3.4.4 国家 X 函数例外

blocks.en:
The x-vectors are processed differently than the rest of the features:
one x-vector is extracted per utterance, then the x-vectors belonging to one speaker in a conversation are pooled using a mean to get one x-vector per speaker. Interactions missing a dyad ID assume that all utterances belong to one speaker, and the pooled x-vector is duplicated.
Finally, an SVM model is trained to predict the familiarity of the conversation directly from the tuple of x-vectors.
SVMs are trained on CPUs using the scikit-learn package [ 17 ] .
blocks.zh:
x 载体的处理方式与其他特性不同:
每句话抽取一名x-vector,然后用一个手段集合对话中一名发言者的x-vector,每个发言者得到一名x-vector。 缺少一个 dyad ID 的相互作用假设所有语句都属于一个扬声器,集合的 x vector 被复制.
最后,一个SVM模型被训练出来,直接从tuple of x-vectors来预测对话的熟悉程度.
SVM使用scikit-learn包对CPU进行培训[17].

blocks.en: 3.4.5 Features fusions
blocks.zh: 3.4.5 特性聚变

blocks.en:
Finally, a fusion of all features is learned as a weighted sum of the conversation-level probabilities P ⁡ ( D i , j | f , C i , j ) P(D_{i,j}|f,C_{i,j}) for all features f ∈ { f\in\{ Spectrogram, MFCC, SPARC, WavLM, X-vector } \} .
The weights are learned either using a linear SVM to maximize the accuracy on the dev set, or all fixed at 1 for unweighted fusion.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: Table 2 shows the classification results shown by each classifier as well as their fusion, compared with existing studies.
blocks.zh: 表2显示与现有研究相比,每个分类者及其聚变的分类结果。

blocks.en:
Familiar-vs-Stranger Classification: Most classifiers show a significant improvement both from human capabilities and audio LLMs.
The ResNet34 classifiers showed up to 86.49% of accuracy for the Spectrograms and up to 0.917 AUC for the MFCCs, leading the way toward low-ressource high-perfoming systems.
The SPARC features showed second-to-last performances, probably explained by the speaker-wise normalization of the values by the model, which would have erased some of the intrinsic properties of the speech related to each speaker.
However, they seems to gain the most from the aggregation by length of the utterances.
The X-vector-based system performed the worst.
blocks.zh:
熟悉-vs-Stranger分类法: 多数分类人员从人的能力和音频LLMs中显示出显著的进步.
ResNet34分类器显示光谱的精确度高达86.49%,MFCC的精确度高达0.917AUC,引领低源高孔系统.
SPARC的特征显示的是第二到最后的表演,可能由该模型的数值按语法正常化来解释,这可以抹去演讲中与每个发言者有关的一些内在属性.
然而,从这些言论的篇幅来看,它们似乎从汇总中得益最大。
以X病毒为基础的系统表现最差。

blocks.en:
Kin-vs-Nonkin Classification: The kinship classification exhibited a much lower range of performances, led by the WavLM-based system with an 85.17% accuracy.
X-vectors-based and SPARC-based systems showed a higher discrimination on that task, with up to 0.909 AUC for the x-vectors.

Cross-feature fusion: The weighted fusion brings almost no improvement, which could be explained by the domain difference between the dev and the test sets: the dev set evaluates on 5-second utterances while the test set uses all of them.
Contrastively, the unweighted fusion shows the best performances across almost all metrics, with up to 0.925 AUC for familiar classification and 0.916 AUC for kinship.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和结论

blocks.en: This article presents DyShip, a study of whether acoustic information from dyadic conversations can reveal speaker familiarity and kinship. Using the Seamless Interaction dataset, we compare five speech representations: MFCCs, spectrograms, WavLM embeddings, estimated vocal tract movements, and x-vectors. Among individual representations, spectral features provide the strongest familiarity results, with MFCCs achieving an AUC of 0.917 and spectrograms reaching an F1 score of 83.76%. For kinship, WavLM achieves the highest accuracy (85.17%) and F1 score (73.69%), while x-vectors yield the highest AUC (0.909). Unweighted fusion further improves F1 and AUC for both tasks, reaching 86.87% and 0.925 for familiarity, and 87.27% and 0.916 for kinship, outperforming SVM-based fusion on all reported metrics. These results support acoustic representations as effective baselines for relationship inference, although comparisons with reported human and audio LLM scores remain subject to differences in evaluation protocols.
blocks.zh: 这篇文章介绍了DyShip,一项研究来自dyadic对话的声学信息能否揭示演讲者熟悉度和亲情度. 使用无缝互动数据集,我们比较了五个语音表达:MFCC,谱系,WavLM嵌入,声道运动估计,以及x-vectors. 在个人表示法中,光谱特征提供了最强的熟悉度结果,MFCC实现0.917的AUC,光谱分数达到83.76%的F1分. 就亲属关系而言,WavLM的准确度最高(85.17%),F1的得分最高(73.69%),而x-vectors的AUC的得分最高(0.909)。 未加权聚变进一步改善了F1和AUC这两个任务,熟度分别达到86.87%和0.925,亲缘关系达到87.27%和0.916,在所有报告的指标上均优于基于SVM的聚变. 这些结果支持声波表示作为关系推论的有效基线,尽管与所报告的人和音频LLM分数的比较仍然受制于评价协议的差异.

blocks.en: Despite these results, several limitations remain. Classification is evaluated on a single dataset , with only 47 and 55 unique dyads in the development and test sets, respectively. Although participants are disjoint across splits, multiple conversations per dyad produce dependent observations and limit generalization. Kinship classification also exhibits substantial class imbalance , making accuracy alone insufficient to characterize performance. The x-vector system illustrates this discrepancy, achieving an AUC of 0.909 but an F1 score of only 45.46% at the evaluated decision threshold. Moreover, utterance-level classification followed by aggregation provides no explicit modeling of turn-taking, cross-speaker adaptation, or temporal dependencies . Finally, correlations between predictions do not identify the acoustic cues captured by each representation. Although unweighted fusion improves performance, the weaker SVM-based fusion results show that combining representations does not necessarily yield gains.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些成果,但仍存在一些限制。 分类由一个单一数据集评价,开发和测试组合中分别只有47个和55个独特的二亚目。 虽然参与者在分裂之间是脱节的,但每个dyad的多个对话会产生依赖性的观察,并限制概括. 金刚石的分类也显示出严重的阶级不平衡,使准确性不足以说明业绩。 x-vector系统说明了这种差异,在评估的决定阈值上达到了0.909的AUC,但F1的得分只有45.46%. 此外,言语一级的分类以及随后的汇总没有为转弯、跨语言的适应或时间依赖提供明确的模型。 最后,预测之间的关联性并不能识别每个表述所捕获的声调提示. 虽然不加权聚变能改善性能,但较弱的基于SVM的聚变结果显示,结合表达不一定产生收益.

blocks.en: Future work will investigate explicit modeling of cross-speaker dynamics by processing complete conversations and extend evaluation to other datasets with relationship annotations, such as CallHome [ 4 , 16 ] . Additional data could broaden the diversity of evaluated relationships and support a more balanced assessment of kinship classification.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将通过处理完整的谈话来调查跨语源动态的明确模型化,并将评价扩展到其他有关系说明的数据集,如CallHome [4,16]. 其他数据可以扩大评估关系的多样性,支持对亲属关系分类进行更平衡的评估。
